_note: Greenhouse sub-pack table. See tools/TEXTURING_NOTES.txt PART 5.
ALL OFFSETS ARE 0 - these three textures are SHRUNK IN PLACE, each at its
own page origin. They do NOT share a tile: the Greenhouse reaches them
through 4bpp clones on three DIFFERENT pages (see the redirection notes at
the top of src/greenhouse.c) -
poison_flower_base -> PSNFLGH  4bpp (704,  0)
pipe_button_off    -> PIPEBTNO 4bpp (512,256)
greenhouse door    -> GRNHSDR  4bpp (320,256)
so a non-zero u_off/v_off would address a neighbour, not the texture.
Shrinking in place keeps every tpage/clut constant valid: no tim_slots.h
change, no disc.xml change, no C change for these three.
The freed space is the REST of each page. Consolidating all three into one
page tile would free two whole pages, but it would move them - new tpage
and clut, and every consumer re-pointed. Left for a later pass.
poison_flower_base and greenhouse door are SHARED. Their OTHER consumers
must scale UVs identically, so maze_one/maze_two/outside_catacombs.json and
stables.json mirror this file. poison_flower_base has TWO TIMs of the same
art (PSNFLGH 4bpp here, PSNFLWR 8bpp in the mazes) - BOTH must shrink.
cuniform pipes IS NOT HERE, and the reason is worth keeping. It was tried
as a 4bpp 256x256 and had to be reverted: the exporter leaves each face's
UV minimum in [0,S), so the maximum reaches S+span. At S=128 that is 192,
which fits 8 bits AND the mask-128 window wraps it correctly. At S=256 it
is 320, which does not fit 8 bits at all, and a 256 texture has no window
that can wrap it. 16 of its 40 faces straddled a tile edge and had to be
shifted onto a different part of the art - the pipes lost their symbols.
A 256 texture needs a UV layout where NO face crosses a tile edge, which
is a Blender job. See TEXTURING_NOTES.txt PART 5.
